description.p: LocalSend lets you share files with nearby devices over your local network. No account, no cloud and no internet connection is required.
This native GNOME app is built with GTK 4 and libadwaita and speaks the LocalSend protocol, so it works with the LocalSend apps on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux.

ul.li: Automatic device discovery on the local network
Send files and folders by picking them or dropping them on the window
Optional PIN protection and encrypted transfers

description.p: Use native GTK and GLib APIs for clipboard, URL escaping, timestamps and hex output, and clean up the codebase.
Clean up compiler warnings and unused code.
Allow removing individual files from expanded multi-file queue groups.
Expand multi-file queue groups to show all files when clicked.
Ellipsize long file names in the queue so the layout no longer expands.
Show file-type icons for items in the send queue.
Release cached dialog state and trim memory when dialogs close or the window is hidden to the tray.
Reduce background memory usage by trimming freed heap memory while hidden and using a lighter server runtime.
Reverted recent memory-optimization experiments that increased RAM usage in practice.

Improved history and settings: attached history dialog, live updates after changes, clearer empty state, click-to-open items, cache controls in Settings, and stable multi-file receive progress labels.
Added a transfer history with a 128 MB cache, quick access to cached files and messages, and per-item copy, open, and delete actions.
Queue files and messages before choosing a device, redesigned home page, in-window confirmation for incoming transfers, and calmer notifications.
Automatic receiving, clipboard text delivery, tray icon and notification fixes.
Improved clipboard handling with wl-copy, added desktop notifications, and background transfer updates.
